hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn (Stop), verify spec discipline: requirements/design/tasks exist, done tasks reference files that really exist, and .kiro/ is not gitignored. Runs standalone too: node .kiro/hooks/scripts/validate-spec-checklist.mjs
hooks.name: Validate spec task checklist

action.prompt: Before writing code, check .kiro/specs/phantom-ledger/tasks.md: implement in task order, and only mark a task [x] after its acceptance criteria pass. If this change is not in tasks.md, add the task first.

hooks.description: Before the agent edits source files, remind it to check tasks.md order first. Agent-action hook (prompt injection into the conversation).
hooks.name: Remind: spec-first before new features
